content: Stripe integration security: the server (not client) must own price/amount computation. Client sends cart contents/product IDs; server looks up authoritative prices from its own DB, computes the total, and creates the PaymentIntent server-side with that amount -- never accept a client-supplied amount. Order fulfillment must be triggered from a verified webhook (payment_intent.succeeded), not from the client-side redirect/success callback, since that callback can be spoofed or dropped. Use idempotency keys on order-creation/charge calls to prevent double-charging on retries.
